tagline: Your mvmOS notifications, apps and own button menus in your own Telegram bot.
description:
Telegram Hub lets every Apps Hub profile connect Telegram bots of its own. You create a bot with @BotFather, paste its token on the Telegram Hub page, press Start in Telegram, and from then on the bot works for you only.

There are three kinds of bot. The Apps Hub bot opens Apps Hub as a Telegram Mini App, signed in without a login screen, and delivers the notifications of all your apps as ordinary Telegram messages in the language of your profile; you can turn off the apps you do not want to hear from. An app bot is dedicated to one app: it opens only that app and brings only its notifications. A custom menu bot gives you a menu of buttons you build yourself.

No app needs any Telegram code. Telegram Hub listens to the shared notification system, so every app that notifies you through mvmOS reaches your bot automatically.
capabilities: Each profile connects its own bots; the server administrator only sets the public HTTPS address.
The Apps Hub bot delivers the notifications of every app, worded in the language of the profile, and opens Apps Hub as a Mini App with automatic sign-in.
Turn off the notifications of individual apps from a collapsible list on the Telegram Hub page.
An app bot opens a single app and brings only that app's notifications.
A bot is private: it is paired with the one Telegram chat that pressed Start, and its token is stored encrypted.
Works with any app, with no Telegram code inside the app.
requirements: A Telegram bot token from @BotFather for each bot.
A public HTTPS address for this mvmOS install — Telegram will not deliver webhooks over plain HTTP.

integrations.name: Any app
integrations.summary: Every notification an app creates through mvmOS for an Apps Hub profile is delivered to that profile's Telegram bot. The app needs no changes.
integrations.requires: Telegram Hub installed, a public HTTPS address set by the administrator, and a bot connected by the profile.
